reviews.text: I was in agony from joint pain when I was 16, but I've been getting better with each treatment here. The doctor has amazing hands!

When my dog ​​developed cervical and lumbar disc herniation and had difficulty walking, my regular veterinarian recommended this hospital, which offers chiropractic treatment, and I started going there. I was desperately looking for a treatment other than surgery, so I am truly grateful that I found Dr. Sue's chiropractic treatment at that time. Several years have passed since then... Dr. Sue and the staff always greet me with a smile, so I feel very at ease entrusting my dog ​​to their treatment. In addition to preventative medicine and chiropractic treatment, they also accurately answer my questions about my dog's behavior, which is educational for me and very helpful in maintaining my dog's health. I can see improvement in symptoms after each treatment. Now my second dog, whom I recently adopted, is also receiving patellar luxation treatment. I would like to continue using this animal hospital to maintain the health of my dogs.
I was unable to walk and sought help from the doctor, but after the treatment I was able to walk again, and I am truly grateful. I highly recommend this to anyone in need.

We were indebted to your clinic for over 17 years, until our beloved dog passed away at the age of 17 years and 9 months. In addition to regular medical care, we also received assistance with canine osteopathy and "SUZUKI Method" training, receiving comprehensive support from both a medical and physical conditioning perspective. We are truly grateful to the doctor and all the nurses for their kindness and gentle care. We are deeply thankful that our senior dog was able to spend her years peacefully and happily thanks to this hospital. Thank you so much for your warm care and support until the very end for 17 years.

I had been a patient there before.

My dog ​​had an abnormal result during a health checkup, and I was suddenly told he had a limited lifespan.

Worried, I made an appointment to go back alone, without my dog, to discuss the treatment plan and what precautions I should take as we continue to live together.

The first thing the doctor said to me when I entered the examination room was, "You're being overly anxious, Mom."

I wish they had considered the feelings of a family worried after being suddenly told they had a limited lifespan.

I immediately switched hospitals because I couldn't trust this hospital as we were going to fight the disease.

Thanks to that experience, I found a good hospital and doctor, and my dog ​​was able to exceed the lifespan I had been told.

It was an incredibly cruel hospital to tell a family they didn't want to know their dog had a limited lifespan and then call them "overly anxious."

This animal hospital provided the expected and effective care for my dog's chronic pain. The staff were courteous, and their explanations of the procedures and risks were clear and easy to understand. The hospital was also kept very clean, and I didn't encounter any problems. I trust them for senior care and gait improvement, so I would like to use their services again and recommend them to my family and friends.

Was the review deleted? After talking for about 5 minutes, they gave my dog ​​an injection and that was it. Is it really okay? I'm scared.

They talked about things unrelated to the symptoms.

They told me to make him sleep in a crate at night...

They said the bed was no good. But I sleep with him in the bed every night.

I took my dog ​​to see Dr. Sue's chiropractic clinic, whose videos I always watch on YouTube. The results were spot-on for my dog! I was surprised at how much lighter his legs felt on the way home! However, it's quite crowded, so the wait is rather long...

My 16-year-old Toy Poodle suffered a torn anterior cruciate ligament in her right hind leg, and we opted for conservative treatment, so we visited the clinic for follow-up care.

I found the clinic through a search on YouTube and other sources, and it was clear that the vet himself loves dogs and is very knowledgeable about handling them, making the visit stress-free.

We discovered that not only her right leg but also her neck was in a very bad condition, and we will be continuing treatment.

Perhaps because she rested quietly for two days after the procedure, she became much more energetic three days later and was able to walk with a steady gait, which surprised me.

Thank you so much.
